Private Independent School in Fulham, London
Fulham Prep School
Over 25 Years of Exceptional Education in London
Fulham Prep School, London, is a co-educational, independent school for children aged 2 to 13 years old. We are proud to be a leading private school in London, and remain committed to providing high-quality education that enables students to discover their full potential in a supportive, inspirational environment. At our school, students attain personal and academic achievement through a child-centred methodology which seeks to highlight, nurture, and develop their unique abilities.
For over 25 years, Fulham Prep School has sought to help children cultivate a love of learning. From Nursery to Preparatory, students are well-equipped with a robust curriculum and modern competencies to flourish in an ever-changing environment. Every child is perfectly unique, and as they grow, they are encouraged to understand the value of their contributions to our school and their local and global communities.
An Inspired School: Your Child’s Gateway to the World
As part of the Inspired Education Group, Fulham Prep students benefit from a global network of over 120 premium schools, offering opportunities to connect, collaborate, and broaden horizons through international exchanges, summer camps, and innovative learning experiences.
My daughter joined Fulham Prep from another school last year, this is our second academic year, and we could not be happier. When I saw what was on offer at Fulham Prep, I thought “this is a no brainer, she has to move”. The first reason is the size of classes: the number of people she socialises with has increased by many folds. Then the amenities supplementing her academics: such as the music and performance building, a dedicated art room, ICT & robotics, a light-filled library, and to top it off, a robust sports department.
I have a child on each campus, Palace Gardens and Queen's Gardens, so I get to see what happens on both campuses. Though they are physically two different sites, they work so closely together making it a seamlessly unified school. I hear my youngest talking about the same teachers that my eldest does – they love all their teachers. I don't know where they've found these amazing teachers, but we're lucky to have them.
I was positively surprised to see how packed their timetables were with a wide variety of subjects. Fulham Prep has specialized teachers to teach different subjects, so the children are exposed to different teachers other than their form tutor. In addition to the expected subjects, from Reception they include French, weekly swimming classes, drama, and computers. In Year 1, they introduce Philosophy. In Year 5, they start doing Latin. These are huge, huge pluses when considering schools – you just don’t realise it, until you’re in it. It is sufficient to say that they have the infrastructure and capacity to keep all students engaged and busy.
Rafael absolutely loves his school. It's a place where all the children are given the potential to shine and thrive to their best selves. It's wonderful to see the admiration and respect the students have for their teachers, as well as each other. Thank you for creating such a wonderful place!
I would like to extend our genuine thanks to the school for the pastoral and academic support given to Nicolas. We have seen him grow into a much more independent and curious young man since he joined the school.
Our Campuses in Fulham
Palace Gardens
Fulham High Street, Fulham (Nursery - Year 2)
Queens Gardens
Greyhound Road, Fulham (Reception - Year 8)
Why Choose Fulham Prep School?
Fulham Prep School helps children identify and develop their talents to give them the confidence to embrace challenges in other areas. From the most academic child to the most creative, to the most driven to the most supportive - our young students are encouraged to take delight in the learning process.
Rather than worry about achieving high grades in a pressurised environment, children are encouraged to discover, enquire and explore topics through practical lessons, excellent resources, open discussions and exciting excursions. This approach leads to long-lasting personal and academic success through an enjoyable and effective process.
The Fulham Prep School community nurtures lifelong learners who are driven by discovery and achieve more than they ever expected. Our students gain a well-rounded, private education complemented by extensive curricular and extracurricular activities to broaden their horizons. At our independent school, boys and girls study peacefully alongside one another. We are proud that pupils of all abilities respect their peers, knowing that every individual has unique gifts that they can share and build upon.
Our passionate teachers are as keen to learn and evolve as their students. They stay up-to-date with the cutting-edge pedagogical methods and are passionate about their fields of expertise. At Fulham Prep School, our students' well-being and long-term outcomes are at the heart of our practices: while good schools achieve good results, great schools empower children to reach their most fulfilling goals.
Outstanding Preparation for 11+ and 13+ Examinations
Exceptional exam preparation in a stress-free environment ensures student well-being and outstanding results
Personalised Methodology
Our practical, child-centred approach considers multiple learning styles and offers individualised attention
A Gateway to The World
Exciting international opportunities as an Inspired student, collaborating with more than 120 premium schools worldwide
Over 25 Years of Experience
Offering academic excellence through effective, interactive and relevant modern education

Global Education in the Heart of London
Fulham Prep School delivers a diverse and varied UK education. Our school's ethos is aligned with Inspired Education, one of the largest global schools groups in the world.
Part of the Inspired Group of Premium Schools
Part of the Inspired Group of Premium Schools
Inspired Education is world-leading global group of over 110 premium schools worldwide. Inspired schools educate more than 90,000 students across 6 continents and offer exciting overseas exchanges in 24 countries. Our students take part in exclusive summer camps and inter school tournaments, and enjoy academic excellence beyond the classroom.
Guaranteed Entry to Inspired Boarding Schools
Guaranteed Entry to Inspired Boarding Schools
Inspired students in secondary education gain automatic access to any of our premium boarding schools across the globe. Discover a world of achievement in the United Kingdom, Kenya, Spain, Vietnam and beyond. Our boarding schools provide 24-hour care, pastoral support, excellent facilities and a nurturing community.
Hand-picked Teachers from around the World
Hand-picked Teachers from around the World
Inspired's passionate teachers deliver world-class curriculums and integrated learning at every stage. Our students benefit from a progressive and challenging academic approach, and are empowered to fully engage in their education with the help of dedicated educators.
Expert University Counselling
Expert University Counselling
Students receive outstanding University counselling from specialist experts. 90% of Inspired students is admitted to their first-choice university, while 1 in 3 gains acceptance to a Russell Group or Ivy League school.
From Prep School onwards, Inspired's subject specialists demonstrate exceptional practices in English, mathematics, science, French, Spanish, physical education, music, drama, dance and public speaking.
Learn more about Inspired
Find out how we can help your child achieve their goals with a personalised approach and a world of opportunity. A rewarding journey towards success begins here.

Our School
Building a Foundation for Success in a Nurturing Environment
For over 25 years, Fulham Prep School's mission has been to secure outstanding outcomes by delivering an exemplary education through innovative, personalised learning strategies. Nurturing the abilities of every child remains at the heart of our ethos.
Fulham Prep School aims to develop pupils who can:
• Creatively and resiliently solve problems • Work independently, collaboratively and lead others • Show respect and compassion as global citizens
We have the following guiding principles:
• Embracing innovation and enquiry • Universal wellbeing • Global responsibility • Positive engagement
A Path Towards Success
At Fulham Prep School, our comprehensive exam preparation exemplifies our ongoing commitment to academic excellence. Each pupil is offered a curriculum featuring a range of subjects and activities, all of which foster open-mindedness and diverse interests, while supporting students as they uncover and develop their strengths.
Our school's hand-picked teachers instil broad-ranging skills and help children build a foundation for successful outcomes within a secure and exploratory setting.
The History of Our School
Fulham Prep School was founded by Jane Emmett, who remains a governor. Since 1996, the school has grown from a single-class institution to educating 700 pupils while retaining a warm, family-like atmosphere.
Fulham Prep School joins Inspired Education. As a member school, we draw upon a remarkable wealth of talent and expertise, offering our pupils a broad global perspective.
We officially become Fulham Prep School, incorporating Fulham Pre-Preparatory and Fulham Preparatory. The Prep School continues to prepare children for a range of destinations with 11+ and 13+ tuition.
Fulham Nursery opens, welcoming a larger Early Years community and establishing the groundwork for those beginning their learning journey at Fulham Prep School.
Curriculum
Our ambitious curriculum is carefully crafted to unlock each child's potential and provide a solid foundation for future academic achievement.
In the Pre Prep (Nursery – Year 2), the curriculum is broad, balanced, engaging and challenging. Strong reading, writing and numeracy skills are vital, and teachers plan the syllabus carefully to ensure that it establishes these essential competencies while offering continuity in learning and pupil progression. The school's core principle is to cultivate an inspiring setting where all children work to the very best of their ability.
As the children move into the lower prep years (Year 3 and 4), the emphasis is placed on providing a smooth transition from the Pre-Prep years, while supporting and fostering our students' development. Children grow gradually more confident and independent, nurturing critical skills and personal qualities as they navigate our broad and aspirational syllabus.
During the upper prep years (Year5-8) is a time of academic rigour when pupils develop a deeper understanding across subjects, culminating in outstanding results in the Common Entrance examinations. Students take on more responsibility and become role models for the lower years while championing our values and ethos. As a result, they leave fully equipped for life in senior school and beyond.
Pastoral Care & Well-being
At Fulham, pastoral care and well-being are at the heart of everything we do. Each student is supported not just academically, but emotionally and socially through a strong network of form tutors, phase leaders and well-being staff, including our wonderful school nurse. Our timetable is designed to enable class teachers and form tutors to meet their pupils at the start and end of the day for check-ins creating a safe, inclusive environment to help students feel seen, heard, and valued. We understand that learning is most effective when students feel secure and supported, so we prioritise mental health, resilience, and positive relationships. This holistic approach is essential in helping every pupil grow into a confident, compassionate individual ready to face the challenges of life.
Mission & Vision
Our school is modern, forward-thinking and focused on identifying and developing each pupil’s talent. We are committed to supporting every child for the duration of their education.
When pupils feel confident, they are willing to try new tasks and apply their knowledge. Our mission is to equip individuals with the tools they need to carve out promising, fulfilling futures.

Educational Philosophy
Our independent school in Fulham provides excellence across the areas of academics, performing arts and sports. As education specialists, we seek to go beyond the confines of a traditional curriculum to teach long-lasting life and communication skills, study methods, time management, and other relevant competencies.

Personalised Tours
Tours are available at both our campuses.
Palace Gardens (Reception to Year 2) - Tuesdays at 9.15am or 11.00am Come and see our purpose built Pre-Prep site, and original home of our Early Years provision.
Queens Gardens (Reception to Year 8) - Wednesdays at 9.15am or 11.00am Originally the home of our Prep site, we now welcome our inaugural Reception cohort for September 2026. We look forward to showing this brand new space to families looking to begin their Reception journey here.
Palace Gardens (Nursery) - Thursdays at 9.15am or 11.00am From September 2026 our Nursery has expanded to include learners from as young as 1 years old. We now also offer provision up to 48 weeks of the year. These tours are specifically for families looking to explore our Nursery.
If you are unable to find a suitable time in the calendar below, please contact our Admissions Team to arrange a private tour at a time that is more convenient for you.
Fulham Prep School Admissions: 020 7386 2460 / admissions@fulhamprep.co.uk
We look forward to meeting you!

Academic Scholarships
We offer academic scholarships based in STEM, creative scholarships for talented artists, dramatists and musicians and sports scholarships for keen sportswomen. Once at Fulham, scholarships are reviewed at least annually based on the performance during the previous school year.
Scholarship awards may be up to 100% of the school fees for the next academic year.
Applicants will complete a CAT4 assessment, a short interview with a member of our SLT and participate in some academic lessons and other activities during the day. The lessons and activities will be observed and used to inform the scholarship awards.
Please see our FAQs page for further information.
Please contact Admissions directly if you would like your daughter to be considered for a scholarship.
A Transformative Opportunity
The Nsouli Scholars Programme is an exciting global initiative that promises to transform lives by enabling 50 extraordinary students at any one time to attend any of Inspired’s prestigious schools on a full scholarship for the duration of their education. The ambition is that the scholarship will provide hundreds of children with an opportunity to receive a truly transformative education.
By opening this path to exceptional individuals, we hope to expand our community, and to empower children of all backgrounds with unrivalled opportunities in academics, sports, the arts and extracurricular activities. In this sense, the Nsouli Scholars Programme is an investment both in education and in shaping the leaders of tomorrow.
This generous endowment honours Nadim Nsouli, who founded Inspired in 2013 as a definitive statement of excellence in private international education. In recognition of Mr Nsouli’s Lebanese heritage and Inspired’s commitment to inclusivity, several scholarships will be awarded to individuals of Lebanese origin.
Inspired schools offer a world-class educational experience that combines academics and engaging extra-curricular activities, producing confident, multi-skilled students who flourish in a competitive and increasingly interconnected world. Along with expert instruction by hand-picked teachers, our students access specialist sports programmes and professional tutelage from leaders in the performing and creative arts. As a result, they leave armed with a robust value system and a love of learning that extends well beyond the classroom.
Inspired is also committed to leveraging new and transformative learning technologies. Inspired AI empowers children to achieve academic excellence by delivering actionable insights that are unique to each student, including strengths and weaknesses. Our partnership with The Royal College of Music and Forte, a revolutionary online platform, enables children to receive personalised music tuition from professionals. Students with musical interests benefit from bespoke private lessons, advancing their practice as creatives and gaining valuable performance experience.
The advantages of our holistic approach to education are evidenced by the fact that Inspired students consistently excel in academic performance, surpassing national and global averages. In 2022, the Average Point Score was 35 for those undertaking the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma, for which the world average was 31.98, while A* scores comprised 27% of our students' A Level grades, compared to 14.6% globally. As a consequence, many are able to attend leading universities, with one in three graduates going on to a Russell Group University or Ivy League College.
The Inspired Group includes top-rated day and boarding schools worldwide, meaning students enjoy access to a diverse international community. Be it through specialised Summer Camps or immersive Global Exchange Programmes, children have the chance to travel broadly and engage meaningfully with different cultures, meet and learn from our esteemed partners, build lifelong networks, and become more independent.
To find out more about our Academic Scholarship and how to apply to our Sixth Form, contact us today.

Premium Nursery School in Fulham
Expanded Early Childhood Education at Fulham Nursery
Fulham Nursery School in London now invites children aged 1 to 4 years old to join an exciting adventure of discovery underpinned by student-focused, holistic education.
We are proud to be expanding with the opening of our 1-year-old class and an extended 48-week term in September 2026, ensuring greater continuity and support for families throughout the year.
Why Choose Fulham Nursery School in London?
Located at Palace Gardens, our Nursery in Fulham, West London, offers an inspiring, purpose-built environment where children thrive and grow into inquisitive, eloquent young students. Since 2022, we have provided families with a flexible Nursery programme that seamlessly balances expert childcare with an accredited EYFS curriculum, enhanced by Inspired’s Early Learning approach. This multi-faceted methodology places the child at the centre of the early learning experience, ensuring every child is equipped with the self-confidence, independence, and academic foundation needed for a seamless transition into reception at Fulham Prep.
Guided by cognitive science and a low student-to-teacher ratio, our experienced Preschool educators tailor learning to each student, giving every student the best chance at success. By blending explorative, child-led play with structured teacher-led sessions that follow the respected EYFS curriculum, we ensure every child feels valued while building a solid foundation for future academic excellence.
Nursery Attendance
Fulham Prep Nursery is open from 8:00am to 6:00pm.
Children can attend:Full day: 8:00am–6:00pmHalf day morning: 8:00am–1:00pmHalf day afternoon: 1:00pm–6:00pm
Annual Attendance Options
The following attendance options are available throughout the year:Term Time: 34 weeks, in line with the school holidays.Term Time Plus: 39 weeks, comprising the 34 term-time weeks plus additional weeks during the school holidays: 1 week in October, 1 week at Christmas, 1 week at Easter and 2 weeks in the summer.Full Time: 48 weeks, providing year-round childcare except for 2 weeks at Christmas and 2 weeks in the summer.
Early Years Funding
We are committed to supporting our families in every way possible and are pleased to confirm our participation in the following Early Years Funding initiatives:
Our Nursery in Fulham at a Glance
At What Age Can My Child Join Fulham Nursery School?
At What Age Can My Child Join Fulham Nursery School?
As of 2026, we welcome children from 1 to 4 years old to our prestigious Nursery programme in Fulham.
Does Fulham Nursery School Offer Wraparound Care?
Does Fulham Nursery School Offer Wraparound Care?
We offer flexible Preschool options to suit the needs of every family. Core hours are from 7.30 am to 5.45 pm, with part-time and full-time childcare provisions available.
What Childcare Facilities Do We Have At Our Nursery School in Fulham?
What Childcare Facilities Do We Have At Our Nursery School in Fulham?
Our British Nursery school features quality, safe, secure, and modern facilities, including engaging classrooms, exciting outdoor spaces, and calming rest areas.
Does Fulham Nursery Offer Meals?
Does Fulham Nursery Offer Meals?
Yes, children at our Preschool near Fulham are offered nutritious meals and snacks throughout the day, supporting growth and sustained energy.
Is It Worth Investing in a Premium Nursery Education for My Child?
Is It Worth Investing in a Premium Nursery Education for My Child?
Yes. The skills developed in Nursery school lay the foundation for higher learning. Equipping your child with the best Nursery education sets them up for not only academic, but also career and personal success throughout their life. At Fulham Nursery, we shape every aspect of our environment, curriculum, and approach to teaching around creating a solid base from which extraordinary futures take flight.
Nursery School Options
Fulham Nursery’s schedule follows a fixed daily timetable. Children who attend our early childcare centre arrive at 8.30 am and leave at 3.30 pm. Parents and carers may extend or change their child’s Preschool timetable by requesting a tailored daycare plan for after-school care.
Please note that additional fees may be required for the following options:
Breakfast Club: From 7.30 am
Early Bird: From 8.00 am
Early Years EYFS Curriculum
We offer an outstanding Preschool education in Fulham. Our fully accredited Nursery curriculum follows a programme similar to that offered at the best private nurseries, preschools and early learning schools in the UK. However, in addition to the EYFS statutory framework outlined by the Department for Education, Inspired’s Early Learning approach further strengthens our education system.
Our early years curriculum aims to:
Fostering independence in early childhood builds the autonomy children need to master lifelong literacy, numeracy, and critical-thinking skills.
We are proud that our Early Years pedagogy effectively supports children as they gain new skills and begin laying the foundation for future education. Fulham Nursery seeks to nurture their natural curiosity before they slowly transition to a more rigorous, teacher-led curriculum.
Expert Educators at Our Fulham Nursery
As experienced Preschool educators, our teachers structure the Nursery timetable to offer variety, balancing explorative child-led learning opportunities with structured teacher-led sessions depending on the topic and lesson objectives. To ensure the highest standards of care and preschool education in Fulham, our teacher-to-student ratio is kept low across all our age groups.
Comprehensive Early Childhood Education in Fulham
We provide Nursery parents with complete wraparound care, supporting children through essential stages like sleep patterns, weaning, toilet training, and key developmental milestones. Our carefully planned timetable encourages children to follow a routine that is balanced with enrichment activities, play, nap time, and meals. We have also recently expanded our provision from 35 weeks to 48 weeks, giving families access to flexible Nursery programmes in London.
Fulham Nursery School Environment
We offer a vibrant and welcoming early years environment. Young learners benefit from an innovative educational setting that promotes cognitive, creative, communicative, and relational development. Healthy development involves assimilation through play, and the youngest members of our community enjoy exploring safe indoor and outdoor spaces under the supervision of highly experienced Nursery teachers.
Experience our Nursery school for yourself
Social Development in the Preschool Years
A fundamental aspect of our approach to early childhood learning is social development. Many of our early years staff are specialist Nursery practitioners and understand the importance of collaborative group work in fostering social-emotional growth. Children learn from each other while working in pairs or small groups and take pride in their contributions to their community during class discussions, art projects, and interactive sessions. As a central aspect of our teaching methodology, collaborative early years education forms the foundation of crucial life skills and fosters critical thinking, group problem-solving, analysis, creativity, and leadership abilities.
Additional Services at Our Nursery School in Fulham
Nutritious Preschool Meals
At Fulham Nursery, we believe a good meal is at the heart of every school day. Lunchtime gives our pupils the opportunity to eat a healthy meal, take a break and socialise. Our meals are prepared on-site, using fresh ingredients, and give learners and staff the fuel they need for the last half of the school day.
We do our best to accommodate specific dietary needs; however, please inform your child’s teacher of any requirements, intolerances and allergies.
Learn more about how our Nursery school in Fulham's personalised approach can help your child thrive.

Open Day
What to Expect - Autumn Term
Open Evening - Palace Gardens
Hosted at our Palace Gardens site. This event is for families with children from Reception to Year 2. Explore our innovative and spacious environment and see how we inspire and motivate our students to excel academically, in the performing arts, and on the sports field. Take a look at our state-of-the-art facilities, chat with our passionate Teachers, and meet our inspirational Headmaster.
Date: Thursday 19th November - 6.00 pm to 7.30 pm
Stay & Play - Palace Gardens
Hosted at our Palace Gardens site. These events are perfect for children looking to join us in either Nursery or Reception, accompanied by a parent or carer. Meet our fantastic Early Years team, experience the expertise of our specialist Teachers, explore the adventure playground, and join in on a range of activities.
Date: Wednesday 14th October - Mini Champions - Sport theme - 9.30 am to 11.00 am Date: Wednesday 2nd December - Festive Fun - Art theme - 9.30 am to 11.00 am
If there are no Open Day places available on the form below or none that fit your schedule, we welcome you to visit the school at your convenience by scheduling a Personalised Tour today!

Our Safeguarding
At Fulham Prep School, the safeguarding of our children is the highest priority. Safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children is everyone’s responsibility at Fulham Prep School. In order to fulfil this responsibility effectively, all professionals should make sure their approach is child centred.
The list below shows the some of our safeguarding team within school. • Designated Safeguarding Lead: Paul Hardwick (Deputy Head) • Deputy Safeguarding Lead: Lesley Warrington (School Welfare Officer) • Deputy Safeguarding Lead: Abigail Reader (Deputy Head - Pre-Prep) • Deputy Safeguarding Lead: Katharine Child (EYFS)
Contact details for the Local Safeguarding Children Board (Hammersmith & Fulham) can be found here. When recruiting, we follow the safer recruitment practice. All interviewing staff have been trained on safer recruitment. These practices help make sure staff and volunteers are suitable to work with children and young people. It’s a vital part of creating a safe and positive environment and making a commitment to keep children safe from harm.
Our safeguarding and safety policies can be accessed here.

Admissions Process
Register Your Interest With Us in a Few Simple Steps:
Contact Us
For detailed information about Fulham Prep School, please send us an enquiry. You are also welcome to book a Personalised Tour. A member of our Admissions Team will contact you as soon as possible.
Our community is typically fully enrolled; however, on occasion, places become available due to relocation or changing family circumstances.
We invite you to contact our Admissions team to discuss current occasional place availability on +4420 7386 2460 or please reach out by clicking on the 'Enquire Now' button above and submitting a query.
Registration
To begin your application, please click the Apply Now button below. After we receive your application, you will be sent login details for your Open Apply Account and must follow the application checklist, ensuring all steps are completed. Please don't hesitate to contact our admissions team if you need any assistance in completing the application process at admissions@fulhamprep.co.uk
Applications must be submitted by the 31st of October the year before entry. A non-refundable registration fee of £150 is payable for each student.
Assessments & Interviews
After registration and where applicable, your child will be invited to take an online assessment and attend an interview with either the Head of School or a member of the Senior Leadership Team.
There are no assessments for Nursery or Reception applicants.
Receive an Offer
Should we conclude that Fulham Prep School is appropriate for your child and entry assessments have been completed successfully, a place will be awarded.
Priority places will be offered to the siblings of existing Fulham Prep School pupils.
Download Admissions Policy
We look forward to meeting your family and welcoming you to our creative, nurturing and supportive independent school in the heart of London.
Learn how we can help your child reach their full potential by contacting us and taking the first step towards academic excellence today.

FAQs
Please see below a list of our most frequently asked questions.
When should I submit my application?
Each step in our admission process is outlined on the website. Early registration is advised.
The main entry point is at reception based at our Pre-Prep - children are admitted to reception in the Autumn term of the school year after they turn 4. Additionally, we have intakes at 7, 8, 11 (school years 3,4, and 7), with occasional places available in other years.
Entry to reception is automatic for children attending the Nursery, and entry to Prep is automatic for pupils from the Pre-Prep.
Do you have a waiting list?
Depending on the date of registration, gender and birth date, applicants are placed on one of three lists:
Main list offers are made in the January of the starting year, and reserve list offers in February.
Do you have a sibling policy?
Siblings of children currently being educated at the school are given priority, subject to the availability of places. A 10% discount is applied to the younger child’s/children’s fees while the oldest child is still attending school.
Download the admissions policy
Is there an entrance test?
Whilst our Pre-Prep School is non-selective and offers of places are considered on a first-come, first-served basis. For occasional places or at entry points including 7/8/11+ children will be invited into the school for a taster day and to sit an online assessment, along with an interview with a member of the Senior Leadership Team. Following this offers will be made based on each child’s individual suitability for the school environment.
If you are ready to submit your application, please complete our online registration form.
What are the school hours?
What are class sizes?
We proudly offers smaller class sizes (up to 20) throughout the Pre-Prep and Prep School.
What school activities are there?
Alongside the extensive curriculum programme of academic, sport, art, music and drama, we also offer a variety of lunchtime and after-school clubs as optional extras, allowing children of different ages to explore a broad range of interests.
Some clubs are operated by our staff and others by external agencies. Occasional half-term and holiday clubs are also provided depending on demand.
What schools do leavers go to?
We are extremely proud of our leaver destinations and the scholarships and awards our children achieve. They move on to an array of competitive senior day and boarding schools at 11+ or 13+. A full list of recent destinations can be found here:
The Parents' Association is very committed and active. Its dual aims are to provide extra-curricular activities for children and parents, and to raise funds for charities, occasionally contributing to the schools' own chosen charity.
All parents are welcome to become members and a class representative will ensure that parents are kept informed of the various events scheduled throughout the year.
Is there school transport?
Several buses are offered free of charge for children attending the school. There are also several other paid bus routes serving the school sites.
Our school has a compulsory school uniform which aims to encourage a sense of identity, belonging and pride in children.
A uniform list is sent out with school admission instructions. The Fulham Prep Parents' Association organises second-hand uniform sales several times a year.
FAQs on Scholarships
What type of scholarships are available?
We offer academic scholarships based in STEM, creative scholarships for talented artists, dramatists and musicians and sports scholarships for keen sportswomen. Once at Fulham, scholarships are reviewed at least annually based on the performance during the previous school year.
There is a programme that scholars are expected to engage in to nurture the talent identified and support the overall school in their chosen specialism.
Scholarship awards may be up to 100% of the school fees for the next academic year.
How can I apply for a scholarship for my child?
Please indicate on your application form that you wish to be considered for a scholarship.
When is the application deadline?
The application deadline is the same as that of the main application deadline.
What is the assessment for the scholarship?
Applicants will complete a CAT4 assessment, a short interview with a member of our SLT and participate in some academic lessons and other activities during the day. The lessons and activities will be observed and used to inform the scholarship awards.
Does my child need to have had tutoring?
We prefer that the children aren’t overly prepared for the assessments as this allows us to understand their natural talent. We are also looking for their love of the area as well!
How can my child prepare for the assessment?
We recommend discussing the process with your child and reassuring them that this is not something to worry about as we are looking for your child to be the best she can be. Your child should feel confident in their interests and be able to share them in class or in a one-to-one interview setting.
How does Fulham Prep School help children with special educational needs or special circumstances during the assessment process?
If your child has a special educational need or special circumstances, please contact our Admissions team to discuss directly. We aim to provide a fair and positive experience for all applicants and make adjustments where possible and practical.
Do you offer bursaries?
No, Fulham School only offer scholarships. However, the scholarship awards can be up to 100% of the school fees.
For more information about our school, contact our Admissions Team, who will be happy to assist you.

Fulham Pre-Preparatory Campus
The Pre-Prep campus at Palace Gardens caters to the needs of our youngest pupils. The smallest members of our community enjoy tailored facilities, bright refurbished classrooms, several outdoor learning areas and playgrounds to accommodate those in early childhood education.
A Victorian building accommodates the Reception classes, two outside classrooms, the school library and computing room. The adjoining 3-storey block, built in 2001, houses classrooms (Years 1 and 2) as well as the gym/assembly hall, music room, science room and art studio. As a whole, the site provides a safe and secure environment for younger children to develop their skills, as well as learning how to work and play together.

Fulham Preparatory Campus
Our Prep School provides a positive environment in which children develop a love of learning as well as curiosity about the world around them.
The Prep School campus features a magnificent building surrounded by an acre of outdoor space. Pupils enjoy a spacious playground, two AstroTurf pitches, and access to excellent local sports facilities. Pupils are taught in several music rooms, a performing arts centre, a dance studio and a stunning library. Two specialist IT suites and three science laboratories provide a stimulating STEAM learning environment.

Governing Board
Mark Snell - Chair of Governors and UK Education Director
Mark has worked in education for 30 years. Prior to joining Inspired as UK Education Director in September 2023, Mark was Headmaster of Wetherby School Notting Hill for 15 years, and Deputy Head for 2. With extensive experience in all aspects of academic, pastoral and co-curricular provision, Mark was also Executive Headmaster of Wetherby School Kensington from September 2022 until April 2023. Mark also brings to governance, his experience as Head of Mathematics at King’s College Junior School, Wimbledon for 5 years and Head of House, at Westminster Under School and Eaton House the Manor.
Ashley Harrold - Chief Executive Officer - UK
Ashley joined Inspired in 2021 as Executive Head of the Online Schools, before being promoted to Online CEO, and is now the Chief Executive Officer for Inspired UK. This followed six years as Headteacher, as well as leading one of the DfE UK National MFL Hubs and setting up the Pavilion & Downs Teaching School Alliance. Holding a B.A Hons and PGCE in History from UCL, as well as the NPQH and NPQEL qualifications, Ashley brings a wealth of experience of school leadership and education innovation.
Mike Lambert - Global Education Director
Prior to joining Inspired as Global Education Director in January 2025, Mike was the Principal at Dubai College for 10 years during which time the school was recognised as the Best British International School in the World in 2019 and the Best British Curriculum School in the UAE in 2021.
In addition to headship, Mike served as a governor at St. Catherine's British International School in Athens, was co-Chair of the HMC Middle East division and the British Schools in Dubai, a member of both the HMC Membership committee and the GSA/HMC Universities committee and is Fellow of the Chartered College of Teaching and the Royal Society of Arts.
Mike holds an MBA in Education Leadership from UCL's Institute of Education, an MA in Social Anthropology from SOAS, the University of London, as well as a BA in Literae Humaniores from the University of Oxford, where Mike was the 1999 Charles Oldham Classical Scholar.
Jez Prior - Safeguarding Governor
Jez is the Global Safeguarding Lead for Inspired and is based in London, UK. Jez was the Head of Safeguarding in Education for West Sussex County Council for six years. Before this position, he served as a senior detective with Sussex Police, leading the county's multi-agency safeguarding response hub. Jez has overseen many significant investigations and is a highly experienced safeguarding inspection and audit officer. Jez has worked very closely with schools throughout his career, including as Chair of Governors. Jez has lectured nationally and internationally on the development of child protection processes within schools and other agencies. He strives to highlight the importance of placing the needs of the child at the centre of safeguarding procedures.

An Inspired School
Inspiring Excellence, Achieving Success
Inspired Education is a leading global group of premium schools, delivering cutting-edge teaching and learning practices to 121 schools in 28 countries across 6 continents. Inspired schools educate 95,000 children worldwide and demonstrate the efficacy of relevant, modern, holistic education with excellent outcomes in the Three Pillars of Academics, Sports, and Performing & Creative Arts.
Inspired schools share a commitment to excellence that extends beyond the classroom. At our school, pupils participate in unrivalled extracurricular programmes, personalised university support, and one-of-a-kind collaborative opportunities to give them the best chance of reaching their goals and becoming well-rounded, compassionate individuals with a broad perspective.
Learn More About Inspired
Inspired's Approach: Three Pillars of Education
As with all Inspired member schools, Fulham Prep School shares a dedication to excellence from Nursery to Sixth Form. We seek to demonstrate exceptional practices across our academic, performing arts and sports programmes while cultivating the ideal setting for children and young adults to thrive.
Inspired schools also share a commitment to education that extends beyond the confines of traditional curriculums. At our school, pupils participate in unrivalled extracurricular programmes, personalised careers support sessions, and one-of-a-kind collaborative opportunities to give them the best chance of reaching their goals and becoming aspiring young people.
Academic Achievement
Academic Achievement
Inspired's commitment to academic excellence informs the central Pillar of the Group's approach to education. Our school's methodology fosters lateral thinking, comprehension, and the innovative application of skills and concepts.
Sports and physical education inform the second Pillar of Inspired's modern approach to education. Inspired schools offer a well-balanced, health-focused setting that caters to all levels of sports practice. At our school, children are encouraged to participate in football, hockey, yoga, tennis and many other activities that promote teamwork, friendship, discipline, well-being and enjoyment.
Creative and Performing Arts inform the third Pillar of education at Inspired. Our students receive specialist music and performing arts tuition as part of the core school curriculum. They may also attend one of our many extracurricular activities to prepare them for exciting opportunities to compete nationally and internationally.
Inspired Schools Around the World
Learn More about Inspired Education
For more information about how our students benefit from Inspired philosophy, contact us today.

Future Schools
At Fulham Prep School, we take great pride in ensuring that our students are confident and fully prepared for their transition to some of the most successful day and boarding schools in London, the UK, and beyond.
We maintain strong, well-established relationships with leading senior schools and provide proactive support to parents throughout the entire process, helping them make informed decisions about the best fit for their child.
With a commitment to high-quality teaching and learning, we prepare students over the course of their time at Fulham Prep School to be thoroughly equipped for various entrance assessments, with formal exam preparation beginning in Year 5.
Fulham Prep School is trusted by senior schools for developing students who are adaptable to change, have well developed thinking skills and are resilient as they embark on the next phase of their educational journey.
